test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate adverb to fill in the blank.**

Ramees works ______ to get through the entrance exam.
solution:
The correct answer is **"hard."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Hard"** means not soft to touch; not easy to break or bend. (कड़ा; जिसे तोड़ना या मोड़ना आसान न हो, कठोर, सख्‍़त)

 
 
• **Example**: *The bed was so **hard**__ that I couldn’t sleep.*
 
 
 
• **"Hard"** is the most appropriate adverb to describe the intensity of Ramees' effort in studying for the entrance exam.
 
• Adverbs modify verbs, and **"hard"** is an adverb that can modify the verb "works" to indicate the degree of effort put into the action.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Ramees works __**hard**__ to get through the entrance exam.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Different: **not the same. (भिन्‍न, अलग प्रकार का, एक जैसा नहीं)
 
• **Early: **near the beginning of a period of time, a piece of work, a series, etc. (किसी कालावधि, कार्य आदि के प्रारंभ में; जल्‍दी, प्रारंभिक)
 
• **Important: **having great value or influence; very necessary. (महत्वपूर्ण; अत्‍यावश्‍यक)
